title: Store Update 1.32.0
body:
# Store Update 1.32.0

Raiders!

This week brings two new colour variants, black and white, for the Macrame Set. If you already own the set, these variants will appear automatically. You will also find a new hair style, the Lob Bangs!

Ermal is switching up his offers today at 4am PDT, 1pm CEST.

See you Topside, //Ossen
